collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

the heading's "(VV4 only)": the event is The Tree of Life only

collection.description: Covered in sap: wash in the soapy pond, or sit quietly under the great tree.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has spent the whole day hauling sap and is covered in it from head to toe. The soapy pond is right there, and so is the shade of the great tree.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) wades into the soapy pond and comes out sparkling clean, smelling faintly of flowers.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) sits under the great tree, sticky and still, and lets the quiet settle over (him/her).
